column2: 时间副词“在/正在”位于动词前，表示动作正在进行或情况在继续。本课有两种形式:(1)在/正在+动词;(2)在/正在+动词+呢。此外，表达正在做的事情还有第三种形式:(3)动词+呢。否定回答时，使用副词“没(有)”。
column3: Shíjiān fùcí “zài/zhèngzài” wèiyú dòngcí qián, biǎoshì dòngzuò zhèngzài jìnxíng huò qíngkuàng zài jìxù. Běn kè yǒu liǎng zhǒng xíngshì: (1) zài/zhèngzài+verb; (2) zài/zhèngzài+verb+ne. Cǐwài, biǎodá zhèngzài zuò de shìr hái yǒu dì sān zhǒng xíngshì: (3) verb+ne. Fǒudìng huídá shí, shǐyòng fùcí “méi (yǒu)”.
column4: The temporal adverbs “在/在” are placed before a verb, expressing that an action is ongoing or a situation is continuing. This lesson introduces two forms: (1)在/正在+Verb; (2)在/正在+Verb+呢. Additionally, there is a third form to express an ongoing action: (3) Verb+呢. For negative responses, the adverb “没(有)” is used.
